name: issueai
description: Hypothesis-driven issue and bug discovery for real codebases.

interface.shortDescription: Find real bugs through contextual hypotheses
interface.longDescription: Understand the repository and product before guessing, retrieve structured historical issue patterns, generate bounded bug hypotheses, and preserve benchmarkable outputs for later validation.
defaultPrompt: Find likely real bugs in this project.
Generate contextual defect hypotheses for this codebase.
